stem.text: When $\text{CH}_2\text{(OH)CH=CHCO}_2\text{H}$ is warmed with a little concentrated sulfuric acid, a cyclic compound is formed.
What is the skeletal formula of the cyclic compound?

A.alt: Skeletal formula: five-membered oxygen-containing ring with a C=O ketone group and a C=C double bond

B.alt: Skeletal formula: five-membered lactone ring with a C=O group, a CH2 group and a C=C double bond

C.alt: Skeletal formula: five-membered lactone ring with a C=C double bond, a CH2 group and a C=O group

D.alt: Skeletal formula: five-membered cyclic anhydride ring with two C=O groups and a C=C double bond
